scenario: Matches that complete together are ordered by their facts (LDET.5.5), not by memory traversal. Drives RIGHT-activation of the A,B join by the B fact, which walks the left memory of A tokens; the A memory has just lost its first entry to a delete, so a runtime that deletes last-into-hole (IRET.28.10.1) and stamps in traversal order holds [a3, a2] and fires a3 first. Pin: assert a1, a2, a3; retract a1; assert b1; pump; messages are ['a2', 'a3'], the order a replay rebuilding working memory by assertion also gives (LDET.5.9). Unconstrained join, so it pins the dense-memory walk and says nothing about an indexed equality-join site. It pins libds (`rete/alpha.c`'s `oa` vector); it does NOT pin Mercury's sort, whose memories stay in insertion order (a traversal-order sabotage left it green, e5627698b) -- `LDET.5.5_self_join` does.
